summary: Venu Holding Corp filed an 8-K reporting the sale of approximately 9.5 acres of land underlying its Ford Amphitheater to O'Neil Roth Ford, LLC for $49.7 million, plus an adjacent 1.1-acre undeveloped parcel for $10.00. The buyer is co-owned by a shareholder and the CEO/Chairman, making it a related-party transaction. The sale is part of a sale-leaseback strategy to generate liquidity, with the purchase price set at an independent appraisal. No specific premium, close date beyond closing, or board recommendation is detailed. Watch for the leaseback terms and any related-party governance scrutiny.
